messages:
Lena: Morning everyone 2-minute sync: we need a concise export/retention playbook for enterprise contracts (90d vs 7y). Goal: low-cost long-term storage + defensible evidence exports.
Sam: Big constraint = search cost. Proposal: searchable operational window (90d) + archived notarized bundles for long-term.
Nina: Infra: archive as immutable, chunked objects named by sha256. Reuse cold bucket + lifecycle rules.
Arman: API sketch: POST /v1/tenants/:id/exports {range, mode: on_demand|scheduled}. Returns export_id and manifest URL.
Legal-Jane: Manifest must include tenant_id, snapshot_ts (RFC3339), sha256 per file, KMS key fingerprint, signer id, and chain-of-custody note.
Sam: Also record a signed audit entry that references export_id in the live audit stream so customers can prove issuance.
Nina: Cost control: default monthly snapshots for large accounts, opt-in per-tenant for nightly. Archive billing tag: retention:archive=true.
Arman: Export format recommendation: gzipped tar with /audit/, /meta/, /signatures/, and manifest.json. Signatures must be verifiable.
Lena: MVP acceptance checklist: 1) export API, 2) immutable archive writes, 3) manifest with required fields, 4) signed audit reference, 5) billing tags emitted.
Legal-Jane: Also need runbook for auditor requests: who can request, SLA for export generation, and deletion proofs.
Sam: Stretch: searchable archive, expedited restore SLA, HSM key escrow. Not in Gate A.
Nina: Monitoring: snapshot queue length, export time P50/P95, archive put failure rate, monthly GB per tenant. Alert if failure >5%.
Arman: Ops edge cases: tenant deletes while export pending; tenant migrates Dedicated->Hosted. Add migration key-rewrap steps.
Lena: Action items: Sam -> API spec + manifest example (due Tue). Nina -> infra cost & lifecycle rules (due Wed). Arman -> billing tag + console mockups (due Thu). Legal-Jane -> contract clause drafts for 90d and 7y (due Tue).
ops-bot: Reminder: retention-sync scheduled 2026-05-07 10:00.
Lena: Thanks team. We'll validate with two customers (one 90d, one 7y) before product review.
